options.name: allow_nonroot
options.description: When true, allow non-root requests to be served. Sets the C(-n) option to C(mountd).

options.name: bindip
options.description: List of IP addresses on which to listen for NFS requests. When this is the empty list, listen on all available addresses.

options.name: domain
options.description: Overrides the default DNS domain name for NFSv4. Passes the C(-domain) option to C(nfsuserd). Ignored unless C(nfsv4) is true.

options.name: krb
options.description: Turn on Kerberos for NFSv4. Forces shares to fail without a Kerberos ticket. This enables the C(gssd) daemon. Ignored unless C(nfsv4) is true.

options.name: mountd_log
options.description: When true, log successful mount requests. Passes the C(-l) option to C(mountd).

options.name: mountd_port
options.description: Specifies the port that C(mountd) should bind to. This passes the C(-p) option to C(mountd).

options.name: nfsv4
options.description: If true, enable NFSv4. Otherwise, use NFSv3. Deprecated. Use `protocols` instead.

options.name: protocols
options.description: List of supported protocols. The elements are any of `nfsv3`, `nfsv4` or their synonyms.

options.name: rpclockd_port
options.description: Specifies the port that C(rpc.lockd) binds to. This passes the C(-p) option to C(rpc.lockd).

options.name: rpcstatd_port
options.description: Specifies the port that C(rpc.statd) binds to. This passes the C(-p) option to C(rpc.statd).

options.name: servers
options.description: The number of NFS servers to create. This value is passed to the C(-n) parameter of C(nfsd).

options.name: statd_lockd_log
options.description: When true, turn on extra logging of C(rpc.statd) and C(rpc.lockd), for debugging. Passes the C(-d) flag to C(rpc.statd) and C(-d 10) to C(rpc.lockd). These are debugging flags and are not normally needed.

options.name: udp
options.description: If true, serve UDP clients. Use this if you have NFS clients that have to use UDP. This sets the C(-u) option to C(nfsd).

options.name: userd_manage_gids
options.description: Use this when a user is a member of more than 16 groups. Passes the C(-manage-gids) option to C(nfsuserd).

options.name: v3owner
options.description: Enable the NFSv3 ownership model for NFSv4. Ignored unless NFSv4 is turned on through `protocols` or `nfsv4`.
